about.title: About BARQ
about.subtitle: A single, trustworthy place to discover and book real tourism experiences.
about.missionBody: To give travelers a fast, transparent way to discover and book tourism experiences, and to give local providers the tools to reach them — without either side losing trust along the way.
about.visionBody: A marketplace where every booking, price, and status update is exactly what it claims to be — starting in Oman, built to grow across the region.
about.platformBody: BARQ connects customers with tourism experience providers through a simple, tracked booking flow — from search to confirmation to completion.

feature.searchBody: Browse real, published experiences with transparent pricing set by each provider.
feature.bookBody: Request a time slot in a few steps and get notified the moment a provider responds.
feature.trackBody: Follow your booking's exact status from request to completion in one place.

about.whyBody: Every booking on BARQ moves through the same tracked lifecycle, so customers and providers always see the same, accurate status — no guesswork, no stale information.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most often.
faq.accountQuestion: Do I need an account to book an experience?
faq.accountAnswer: Yes. You sign in with your phone number and a one-time verification code — no password to remember.
faq.bookingQuestion: How does booking an experience work?
faq.bookingAnswer: You submit a booking request with your preferred time slot and number of seats. The provider then confirms it, and you're notified as soon as that happens.
faq.cancellationQuestion: Can I cancel a booking after requesting it?
faq.cancellationAnswer: Yes — you can cancel from My Bookings while the request is pending or confirmed. Cancellation isn't available once the experience is in progress or completed.
faq.paymentAnswer: Pricing is set by each provider and shown before you book. Payment details are handled separately from the booking request itself.
faq.providerQuestion: How do I become a provider on BARQ?
faq.providerAnswer: Provider accounts go through an approval step before their experiences appear publicly. Once approved, providers manage their own services, availability, and bookings from the Provider Dashboard.

bookingHelp.title: Booking Help
bookingHelp.subtitle: A walk-through of how booking an experience works, start to finish.

step.searchBody: Browse published experiences, filter by price or provider, and open the one you're interested in.
step.requestBody: Choose an available time slot and the number of seats, then submit your booking request.
step.confirmBody: The provider reviews your request. You'll see a notification and an updated status the moment they confirm it.
step.cancelBody: While your booking is pending or confirmed, you can cancel it any time from My Bookings — no cancellation option appears once it's in progress or completed.

providerHelp.title: Provider Help
providerHelp.subtitle: Managing your experiences and bookings on BARQ.

topic.servicesBody: Create, edit, publish, pause, or archive your experiences from the Services section of your Provider Dashboard.
topic.availabilityBody: Open time slots and set capacity for each experience so customers can see and request them.
topic.bookingsBody: Review incoming booking requests and confirm or manage them from the Bookings section — requests awaiting your response are clearly flagged.
topic.dashboardBody: Your dashboard shows real booking and service metrics — figures reflect only what has actually happened on the platform.

contact.title: Contact & Support
contact.subtitle: How to reach us and get help.
contact.noticeBody: A dedicated support inbox or contact form isn't wired up on BARQ yet. In the meantime, the Help Center below covers the most common questions.
contact.helpCenterBody: FAQs, booking guidance, and provider guidance are all available there right now.
contact.bookingIssuesBody: Open the booking from My Bookings — its detail page shows the full status history and current state.

section.cancellationBody: A booking can be cancelled free of charge while it is in Pending or Confirmed status. Once an experience is in progress or has been completed, cancellation is no longer available. This rule applies the same way to every booking on BARQ.
